## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix nested CLI arguments for schemas without an explicit type by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/931
### 🚀 New Features
* Add integration tests for Premium NodeBalancer changes by @psnoch-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/933
### 💡 Improvements
* Update interactive config token access check by @mgwoj in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/881
* Adjust integration tests for tags by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/936
### 🧪 Testing Improvements
* Retest and refactor tests skipped due to ARB-8019 by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/930
* Fix failing backup tests by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/934
### 📦 Dependency Updates
* build(deps): bump WyriHaximus/github-action-get-previous-tag from 2.0.0 to 2.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/929
